literal_meaning: টেনে-টানার শব্দানুকরণ (onomatopoeic expression imitating straining or pulling)
figurative_meaning_en: somehow; by any means; with great difficulty
similar_in_english: by the skin of one's teeth
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে টায়টায় করে পরীক্ষায় উত্তীর্ণ হলো।
গ্রামের লোকেরা টায়টায় করে জীবন যাপন করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He somehow passed the exam with great difficulty.
The villagers are scraping by in their daily lives.
note: This idiom uses reduplication typical in Bengali for emphasis on effort; variants reflect regional pronunciations.
